images.title: Cancel 25 twos from 100 twos
images.purpose: Shows 2¹⁰⁰ ÷ 2²⁵ as a long strip of 100 factors over a short strip of 25, where the 25 cancel and 75 are left, so the quotient is 2⁷⁵.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. A fraction layout: one long bar above a dividing line, one short bar below it.
images.exact_structure: Above a dark horizontal fraction line, one long bar split into two parts: the left quarter is grey (#6B7280) with one diagonal strike line through it, the right three quarters is teal (#0072B2). The whole long bar is labelled 100 twos above it, and the teal part is labelled 75 left. Below the fraction line, one short grey bar exactly as long as the grey quarter above, aligned under it, also struck through, labelled 25 twos. A small amber (#E69F00) word cancel between the two struck parts. To the right of the layout the label 2¹⁰⁰ ÷ 2²⁵ = 2⁷⁵. Bar lengths are in the ratio 100 to 25. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Dividing powers of the same base subtracts the exponents: 100 − 25 = 75.
images.description: Shows 2¹⁰⁰ ÷ 2²⁵ as a long strip of 100 factors over a short strip of 25, where the 25 cancel and 75 are left, so the quotient is 2⁷⁵.

image_decisions.why: The cancelling strips show why the exponents are subtracted, not divided.
